# Design task: comparison-inspector

Branch: design/comparison-inspector. PR target: build/composer. Status: not started. Create from the current build tip when assigned.

Dependencies: minimal G1 contracts and baseline. Requirements: R03, R09, R13, R17.

Objective: one existing reference comparison with exact source records, saved numerical result, plotted subset and adjacent data/calculation/analysis-code/render-code/reproduction views.

Ownership: coordinated capture and registered presentation changes. Reuse saved calculations; retain approved code/helpers/environment identity. Do not introduce a new statistic, audience engine or hidden computation in R/JavaScript.

Acceptance: positive/non-positive baselines; missing/repeated/absent periods under current rules; tampered/rehashed evidence; exact plotted subset; escaped labels; stable reorder/duplicate IDs; actual report-runtime R tests; browser disclosure/focus/narrow-layout review.

Handoff: real G2 report plus candidate/fixture/manifest/review package, not mock HTML alone. Require human visual disposition before checkpoint acceptance. Record exact path ownership, commands/exits, limits and backout. Follow [handoff](../HANDOFF.md), [ledger](../requirements.json) and [review](../REVIEW_AND_RESUME.md).
